I think they will not be reused much and I think it's not trivial to get good names for them. is there a recording?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content:
The following is in Deneb's spec
```
    degree_poly = int.to_bytes(FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB, 16, ENDIANNESS)
```
Isn't that unnamed constant `16` a bit weird here instead of being named before?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <dannyryan> Agreed, magic numbers are bad and avoided throughout the spec

excerpts.author: popef
excerpts.content:
We have both
```
degree_poly = int.to_bytes(FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB, 8, ENDIANNESS)
```
and
```
degree_poly = int.to_bytes(FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB, 16, ENDIANNESS)
```
Additionally, we also have
```
num_commitments = int.to_bytes(len(commitments), 8, ENDIANNESS)
```
All of them are used just to compute the fiat-shamir challenge. I think they will not be reused much and I think it's not trivial to get good names for them.
